runtime.vqf: 2.1.2 (qmt declared dependency; pinned for the host environment)

parameter_notes.tauAcc: official accelerometer correction half-response time in seconds
parameter_notes.tauMag: official magnetometer correction half-response time in seconds; unused when mag is omitted
parameter_notes.zeta: unitless official bias-estimation strength; zero disables gyro-bias adaptation
parameter_notes.accRating: official raw accelerometer rating; one enables the documented behavior
parameter_notes.initBias_sign: qmt batch API negates initBias before passing it to the C++ reset; selected value is zero
parameter_notes.selected_initial_state: official block command(['reset']) sets identity quaternion and zero internal bias

six_axis_path.batch: qmt.oriEstIMU(..., mag=None); official Cython wrapper supplies a zero magnetometer vector
six_axis_path.streaming: qmt.OriEstIMUBlock.step(gyr, acc, zero_mag); upstream Cython signature requires an ndarray, and the C++ source skips magnetic correction when all three components are zero
six_axis_path.execution: causal per-sample update; no offline OriEstIMU variant used

reset_findings.documented_command: ['reset'] resets orientation quaternion to identity and gyro bias to zero
reset_findings.source_observation: resetEstimation does not reset validAccDataCount or ratingWindow
reset_findings.adapter_policy: construct a new block on every adapter reset, then call the documented reset command
